articles.summary: GLENS FALLS, N.Y. (January 29, 2026) – Arrow Financial Corporation (NasdaqGS® – AROW) ("Arrow") reported net income of $14.0 million, and fully diluted earnings per share ("EPS") of $0.85 for the fourth quarter of 2025, versus $4.5 million and EPS of $0.27, for the same period in 2024.
